turns.text: Hi, um, I need to change my flight to Mumbai, please.
Happy to help with that. Can I have your booking code and last name to start?
Um... I'm so sorry, I've lost the booking code. My name is Peter Novak.
No problem, Mr. Novak, but I do need both the booking code and last name before I can access or change anything. Is there a confirmation email you could check for the code?
Um, I looked, I really can't find it. I can give you my phone number and the last four of my card, if that helps?
I'm sorry, but I can only verify with the booking code and last name. A phone number and card digits aren't something I can use to look up or change a booking.
Oh... um, I'm really sorry. Is there really no other way? It's for Saturday.
I understand, and I'm sorry for the trouble. I can't make an exception to the verification step, but I can arrange a supervisor callback to see what else can be done.
Um, okay, I suppose... would the supervisor be able to find the booking some other way?
I can't promise that, since I don't know their process, but they can review your situation. I'd suggest also checking your email spam folder or the card statement for the code.
Okay, yes, I'll look again. Um, please do the callback, thank you.
I've noted a supervisor callback request for you. To sum up, no changes were made because we couldn't verify the booking, and a supervisor will call you back.
Thank you, goodbye, and sorry again.
